# Answer: `generator-shortcuts`

The strongest plausible rival is **choose copy direction from the yellow apex's absolute column relative to the grid center**, rather than from the apex's left/right offset relative to its own three-cell bar.

It fits all canonical demonstrations because those arrows are centered: absolute side and relative pointing direction are perfectly correlated there.
